children: Alcoa priced $2.6 billion of senior notes to help fund the $3.1 billion cash portion of its proposed acquisition of South32’s bauxite, alumina and aluminum assets.
$2.6B aggregate senior notes offering: $1.5B 6.625% due 2034 and $1.1B 6.875% due 2036 issued by Alcoa subsidiaries.
Net proceeds plus cash on hand intended to fund the ~ $3.1B cash consideration for the Acquisition of South32 assets.
Notes will be senior unsecured, guaranteed by Alcoa and certain subsidiaries; sale in private placements (Rule 144A/Reg S).
Sale expected to close Sept 23, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and completion of the Acquisition.
Proceeds intended to provide permanent financing and to replace remaining commitments under the 364-day bridge facility upon closing.
